associates.clause: A person closely associated with a PDMR, being: (a) a family member (meaning a spouse, civil partner, or dependent children or stepchildren of the PDMR or a relative who has shared the same household as the PDMR for at least one year on the date of Dealing) or (b) a company, trust, partnership or entity:
associates.reasoning: The Policy defines PCA to include a PDMR's spouse or family member and any company, trust or entity they control, and requires PDMRs to bind their PCAs to the Closed Period and notification rules (section 13), so the rules reach associates for the senior tier though general Personnel have no equivalent extension.

findings.question: cash_hedge
findings.clause: All Rio Tinto Personnel who have access to Inside Information about the Rio Tinto Group must not: (a) Deal in Rio Tinto Securities (on their own account or for the account of another person); (b) advise, procure, recommend, encourage or induce another person to Deal in Rio Tinto Securities; and/or (c) disclose Inside Information to any other person (whether directly or indirectly), if the Rio Tinto Personnel knows or ought reasonably to know that the other person may use the Inside Information to Deal (or advise, procure or encourage someone else to Deal) in Rio Tinto Securities.
findings.reasoning: Ordinary Rio Tinto Personnel who are not Restricted Persons or PDMRs are bound only by the Insider Dealing prohibition in section 5.1; no clause permits or restricts hedging for this tier, so the activity is governed only by the general law.

findings.question: physical_hedge

findings.reasoning: The same section 5.1 prohibition is the only rule binding this tier; nothing in the Policy addresses a physically settled hedge for Personnel outside the Restricted Person or PDMR categories.

findings.question: encumber
findings.clause: All Rio Tinto Personnel who have access to Inside Information about the Rio Tinto Group must not: (a) Deal in Rio Tinto Securities (on their own account or for the account of another person); (b) advise, procure, recommend, encourage or induce another person to Deal in Rio Tinto Securities; and/or (c) disclose Inside Information to any other person (whether directly or indirectly), if the Rio Tinto Personnel knows or ought reasonably to know that the other person may use the Inside Information to Deal (or advise, procure or encourage someone else to Deal) in Rio Tinto Securities.
findings.reasoning: No clause permits or restricts Personnel outside the Restricted Person and PDMR categories from encumbering their vested Rio Tinto Securities; section 5.1's Insider Dealing prohibition is their only constraint.

findings.question: borrow_against_stock
findings.clause: All Rio Tinto Personnel who have access to Inside Information about the Rio Tinto Group must not: (a) Deal in Rio Tinto Securities (on their own account or for the account of another person); (b) advise, procure, recommend, encourage or induce another person to Deal in Rio Tinto Securities; and/or (c) disclose Inside Information to any other person (whether directly or indirectly), if the Rio Tinto Personnel knows or ought reasonably to know that the other person may use the Inside Information to Deal (or advise, procure or encourage someone else to Deal) in Rio Tinto Securities.
findings.reasoning: The margin lending and secured financing prohibition in section 12.3(d) applies only to PDMRs; ordinary Personnel are left with only the section 5.1 Insider Dealing prohibition.

findings.question: borrow_against_derivative
findings.clause: All Rio Tinto Personnel who have access to Inside Information about the Rio Tinto Group must not: (a) Deal in Rio Tinto Securities (on their own account or for the account of another person); (b) advise, procure, recommend, encourage or induce another person to Deal in Rio Tinto Securities; and/or (c) disclose Inside Information to any other person (whether directly or indirectly), if the Rio Tinto Personnel knows or ought reasonably to know that the other person may use the Inside Information to Deal (or advise, procure or encourage someone else to Deal) in Rio Tinto Securities.
findings.reasoning: As with a loan secured directly on the shares, no clause reaches a loan secured on a derivative for Personnel outside the Restricted Person and PDMR categories; only section 5.1 applies to them.

findings.question: stock_loan
findings.clause: All Rio Tinto Personnel who have access to Inside Information about the Rio Tinto Group must not: (a) Deal in Rio Tinto Securities (on their own account or for the account of another person); (b) advise, procure, recommend, encourage or induce another person to Deal in Rio Tinto Securities; and/or (c) disclose Inside Information to any other person (whether directly or indirectly), if the Rio Tinto Personnel knows or ought reasonably to know that the other person may use the Inside Information to Deal (or advise, procure or encourage someone else to Deal) in Rio Tinto Securities.
findings.reasoning: No clause addresses lending Rio Tinto Securities under a title-transfer arrangement for this tier; section 5.1 remains their only constraint.

findings.question: lender_enforcement
findings.clause: All Rio Tinto Personnel who have access to Inside Information about the Rio Tinto Group must not: (a) Deal in Rio Tinto Securities (on their own account or for the account of another person); (b) advise, procure, recommend, encourage or induce another person to Deal in Rio Tinto Securities; and/or (c) disclose Inside Information to any other person (whether directly or indirectly), if the Rio Tinto Personnel knows or ought reasonably to know that the other person may use the Inside Information to Deal (or advise, procure or encourage someone else to Deal) in Rio Tinto Securities.
findings.reasoning: Section 10's exclusion for a secured lender's enforcement sale is expressed as available to Restricted Persons; for Personnel outside that category the Policy says nothing, leaving only the section 5.1 Insider Dealing prohibition.

findings.question: cash_hedge
findings.clause: PDMRs are prohibited from undertaking any of the following Dealings with respect to Rio Tinto Securities: (a) Dealing in derivative products issued over or in respect of Rio Tinto Securities;
findings.reasoning: PDMRs are expressly banned from dealing in derivative products over Rio Tinto Securities, which reaches a cash-settled hedge such as a collar, put or swap regardless of whether the underlying shares are vested and unrestricted.

findings.question: physical_hedge
findings.clause: PDMRs are prohibited from undertaking any of the following Dealings with respect to Rio Tinto Securities: (a) Dealing in derivative products issued over or in respect of Rio Tinto Securities;
findings.reasoning: The same ban on dealing in derivative products is settlement-method neutral and so also prohibits a physically settled hedge such as a collar or put over vested shares.

findings.question: encumber
findings.clause: they have obtained prior written clearance to Deal and Dealing is carried out in accordance with sections 14 and 15 of this Policy.
findings.definition: using as security, or otherwise granting a charge, lien or other encumbrance;
findings.reasoning: PDMRs are Permanent Restricted Persons and so may only Deal in Rio Tinto Securities, including using them as security, with prior written clearance under section 9.1; the Dealing definition's item (c) sweeps encumbering the shares into that clearance requirement.

findings.question: borrow_against_stock
findings.clause: entering into margin lending or other secure financing arrangements in respect of Rio Tinto Securities.
findings.reasoning: PDMRs are expressly prohibited from margin lending or any other secure financing arrangement in respect of Rio Tinto Securities, which bans a loan secured against the vested shares.

findings.question: borrow_against_derivative
findings.clause: entering into margin lending or other secure financing arrangements in respect of Rio Tinto Securities.
findings.definition: entering into margin lending or other secure financing arrangements in respect of Rio Tinto Securities.
findings.reasoning: The ban reaches 'other secure financing arrangements in respect of Rio Tinto Securities', wording broad enough to cover financing in respect of securities generally rather than only financing secured directly by the shares, so it also bans a loan secured on a derivative over the shares; in any event PDMRs cannot hold such a derivative under section 12.3(a).

findings.question: stock_loan
findings.clause: they have obtained prior written clearance to Deal and Dealing is carried out in accordance with sections 14 and 15 of this Policy.
findings.definition: any other transaction or the exercise of any power or discretion, effecting a change of ownership of beneficial interest;
findings.reasoning: Lending the shares under a title-transfer securities loan changes the ownership of a beneficial interest, which the Dealing definition's item (d) sweeps in as a Dealing; as Permanent Restricted Persons, PDMRs may only do this with prior written clearance under section 9.1.

findings.question: lender_enforcement
findings.clause: a disposal of Rio Tinto Securities that is the result of a secured lender exercising their rights.
findings.reasoning: Section 10 excludes a secured lender's enforcement sale from the operation of the Policy and states that excluded dealings may be undertaken by Restricted Persons, which includes PDMRs, at any time without prior written clearance, subject only to the Insider Dealing prohibition.
